title: DeFA: Dependency-Guided Failure Attribution for LLM Agents
title_zh: DeFA：面向LLM智能体的依赖引导失败归因

paragraphs.en: Errors in LLM agent executions and their visible consequences can be separated by many steps, making decisive-error localization a matter of understanding both step content and step dependencies. We introduce DeFA, a dependency-guided framework for agent failure attribution. DeFA first combines protocol relations and semantic dependencies into an event dependency graph spanning the trajectory. It then identifies events that may violate task requirements and traces their sources and subsequent effects to construct a failure propagation graph. Finally, DeFA uses step evidence and the steps’ roles in failure propagation to identify the decisive error, responsible agent, and error category. To support long trajectories, DeFA partitions executions into segments and combines the current segment’s detailed content with summaries of the other segments, giving local diagnosis access to global execution context. Across Who&When and the Who&When Pro text subset, DeFA achieves the highest responsible-agent and exact step accuracy with all evaluated backbones, and the highest failure-mode accuracy among taxonomy-aligned methods on Pro. Further experiments on image and video trajectories demonstrate its applicability to multimodal failure attribution. Ablations support the contributions of segmentation, the event dependency graph, and the failure propagation graph. Using DeFA’s diagnostic feedback for skill evolution in Trace2Skill improves downstream task accuracy by 6–15 percentage points over the native pipeline, showing that the diagnoses can also support agent improvement on subsequent tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型智能体执行中的错误与其可见后果之间可能相隔许多步骤，这使得关键错误的定位既需要理解步骤内容，也需要理解步骤之间的依赖关系。 我们提出 DeFA，一个面向智能体失败归因的依赖引导框架。 DeFA 首先将协议关系与语义依赖结合，构建出覆盖整个轨迹的事件依赖图。 随后，它识别可能违反任务要求的事件，并追溯其来源与后续影响，从而构建失败传播图。 最后，DeFA 利用步骤证据以及各步骤在失败传播中的角色，识别出关键错误、责任智能体和错误类别。 为支持长轨迹，DeFA 将执行过程划分为多个分段，并将当前分段的详细内容与其他分段的摘要相结合，使局部诊断能够获取全局执行上下文。 在 Who&When 以及 Who&When Pro 文本子集上，DeFA 在所有被评估的骨干模型上都取得了最高的责任智能体准确率和精确步骤准确率，并在 Pro 上于与分类体系对齐的方法中取得了最高的失败模式准确率。 在图像和视频轨迹上的进一步实验证明了该方法在多模态失败归因中的适用性。 消融实验验证了分段、事件依赖图和失败传播图的贡献。 在 Trace2Skill 中使用 DeFA 的诊断反馈进行技能演化，相比原生流程将下游任务准确率提升了 6–15 个百分点，表明这些诊断还能支持智能体在后续任务上的改进。

paragraphs.en: When an LLM agent fails a task, the final outcome rarely reveals which earlier decision was responsible. Agents interleave reasoning, tool use, and communication ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) , producing trajectories in which an error and its visible consequences may be separated by many steps. Failure attribution identifies the responsible agent and the decisive error step ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , providing specific evidence for debugging and subsequent improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 当大语言模型智能体（LLM agent）未能完成任务时，最终结果很少能揭示是哪一个更早的决策导致了失败。 智能体在推理、工具使用与通信之间交替进行（Yao et al., 2023; Wu et al., 2024），所产生的轨迹中，错误与其可见后果之间可能相隔许多步骤。 失败归因旨在找出应负责任的智能体以及导致决定性错误的步骤（Zhang et al., 2025; Liu et al., 2026），从而为调试和后续改进提供具体证据。

paragraphs.en: The difficulty lies in tracing how errors arise and propagate through execution to identify the decisive error behind downstream symptoms. Suppose an agent misreads a retrieved value, another agent uses it in a calculation, and the final answer repeats the incorrect result. The final answer reveals the failure, but the earlier interpretation may be the decisive error. Empirical studies likewise examine failure onset and propagation in agent trajectories ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Attribution must therefore examine what information a step received, how it used that information, and what happened afterward. This becomes harder when relevant evidence is distributed across a long trace ( Liu et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 困难在于追踪错误如何产生并通过执行过程传播，从而找出导致下游症状的决定性错误。 假设一个智能体误读了一个检索到的值，另一个智能体在计算中使用了它，而最终答案重复了这个错误结果。 最终答案暴露了失败，但更早的解释可能才是决定性错误。 实证研究同样考察智能体轨迹中失败的发生与传播（Zhao et al., 2026）。 因此，归因必须考察某一步接收了什么信息、如何使用该信息，以及之后发生了什么。 当相关证据分布在很长的轨迹中时，这变得更加困难（Liu et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Existing attribution frameworks use global judgments, sequential checks, or binary search ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , as well as constraint validation, multi-agent investigation, and hierarchical diagnosis ( Barke et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Our focus is to connect suspicious events with the execution that made them consequential. A local deviation must be examined together with its upstream sources and the later actions that adopted, amplified, or corrected its effects. Reconstructing these relations brings distributed evidence together to explain how the execution failed.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的归因框架采用全局判断、顺序检查或二分查找（Zhang 等，2025），以及约束验证、多智能体调查和层次化诊断（Barke 等，2026；Li 等，2026；Wang 等，2026）。 我们的重点是将可疑事件与使其产生严重后果的执行过程联系起来。 局部偏差必须与其上游来源以及后续采纳、放大或纠正其影响的行为一起考察。 重建这些关系可以将分散的证据汇集起来，解释执行是如何失败的。

paragraphs.en: We introduce DeFA , a framework for dependency-guided failure attribution from recorded trajectories. DeFA first combines protocol relations and semantic dependencies into an event dependency graph spanning the trajectory. Building on this structure, it identifies events that may violate task requirements and traces their sources and subsequent effects to construct a failure propagation graph. It then combines trajectory content and propagation relations to identify the decisive error step, responsible agent, and error category. For long trajectories, DeFA uses segmented analysis, combining the current segment’s detailed content with summaries of the other segments so that local diagnosis can use both concrete step evidence and global execution context.

paragraphs.en: Against seven baselines, DeFA leads in responsible-agent and exact step accuracy on Who&When with all three backbones, improving exact step by 7.6–9.8 percentage points. On 300 Pro text trajectories, it also achieves the highest responsible-agent and exact step accuracy with all three backbones, as well as the highest failure-mode accuracy among taxonomy-aligned methods. On 100 multimodal trajectories, it improves exact step accuracy by 6.0–7.0 points across both backbones. Ablations show that segmentation, the event dependency graph, and the failure propagation graph each contribute to attribution accuracy. Removing propagation relations lowers exact step accuracy even when the adjudication set is held fixed, supporting their role in identifying the decisive error. Downstream experiments integrate DeFA’s diagnostic feedback into Trace2Skill, improving test accuracy over the native pipeline by 6–15 percentage points across human-written and model-generated initial skills and demonstrating its utility for agent improvement on subsequent tasks.

paragraphs.en: We introduce a failure attribution framework that combines protocol relations and semantic dependencies into an event dependency graph to identify suspicious events, trace their contribution to task failure, and locate the decisive error and responsible agent.

paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了一个故障传播图，将可疑事件与其上游来源和下游影响连接起来，追踪错误是如何被引入、传播和采纳的，以支持关键错误的归因。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate gains in precise attribution across text and multimodal evaluations, and show that DeFA’s diagnostic feedback improves downstream skill evolution by 6–15 percentage points over native Trace2Skill.
paragraphs.zh: 我们展示了在文本和多模态评估中精确归因的收益，并表明 DeFA 的诊断反馈使下游技能演化相比原生的 Trace2Skill 提升了 6–15 个百分点。

(2026) study coding-agent failure development and recovery.

paragraphs.en: AgentRx supplies validated constraint violations to an attribution judge ( Barke et al., 2026 ) , VerifyMAS tests taxonomy-derived hypotheses ( Qiao et al., 2026 ) , and DeepDebug combines global reading, focused investigation, and cross-examination ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . ErrorProbe detects local anomalies using a failure taxonomy and traces backward from observed symptoms to focus the investigation. Specialized agents then propose, investigate, and verify error hypotheses using executable evidence ( Li et al., 2026 ) . CockpitHAT performs hierarchical diagnosis for embodied multi-agent cockpits, integrating dialogue and other execution evidence with a panel of analysts. Its consensus procedure weighs analyst confidence and emphasizes failures with greater safety consequences ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . EDGE studies attribution of multiple error categories within a trajectory, combining a two-stage LLM judge for detection with counterfactual rollout analysis for interpreting errors and potential repairs ( Hou et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: AgentRx 为归因裁判（Barke et al., 2026）提供经过验证的约束违例，VerifyMAS 测试基于分类法得出的假设（Qiao et al., 2026），DeepDebug 则结合全局阅读、聚焦调查与交叉审查（Zhu et al., 2026）。 ErrorProbe 利用失败分类法检测局部异常，并从观察到的症状出发反向追踪，以聚焦调查。 随后由专门的智能体提出、调查并验证错误假设，使用可执行的证据（Li et al., 2026）。 CockpitHAT 为具身多智能体驾驶舱执行层次化诊断，将对话及其他执行证据与一组分析员相结合。 其共识机制会权衡各分析员的置信度，并更强调具有更大安全后果的失败（Wang et al., 2026）。 EDGE 研究轨迹内多种错误类别的归因，将用于检测的两阶段 LLM 裁判与用于解释错误及潜在修复的反事实推演分析相结合（Hou et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: The event dependency graph represents each step as a node in V = { 1 , … , T } V=\{1,\ldots,T\} and combines protocol relations with semantic dependencies. It records how steps pass and use instructions, results, and state.

paragraphs.en: Protocol relations capture interactions defined by the agent framework’s conventions, such as task delegation and its execution, or tool requests and their results. Semantic dependencies capture how later steps refer to or use earlier content, such as adopting a previous conclusion or using a retrieved value in a calculation.
paragraphs.zh: 协议关系捕获由智能体框架的约定所定义的交互，例如任务委派及其执行，或工具请求及其结果。 语义依赖捕获后续步骤如何引用或使用先前内容，例如采纳先前的结论，或在计算中使用检索到的值。

paragraphs.en: DeFA first compresses oversized step content into a normalized trajectory τ ~ \tilde{\tau} , preserving step identities and actors under instructions to retain facts, provenance, and action status. An LLM then induces protocol rules from message roles, formats, and interaction patterns. Each rule specifies source and target matching conditions, a pairing procedure, and the resulting relation. A deterministic interpreter scans τ ~ \tilde{\tau} to form the protocol edge set E p E_{\mathrm{p}} : each edge ( i , j ) (i,j) links a source step to a matched later step, such as a tool request to its result or a delegation to its execution. The interpreter supports next-match, all-match, FIFO, and LIFO pairing to accommodate different interaction patterns. These edges guide segmentation and complement semantic dependencies.
paragraphs.zh: DeFA 首先将过长的步骤内容压缩为归一化轨迹 τ ~ \tilde{\tau}，在指令下保留步骤标识与执行者，以维持事实、来源与动作状态。 随后，大语言模型从消息角色、格式和交互模式中归纳出协议规则。 每条规则指定源和目标的匹配条件、一个配对程序以及由此产生的关系。 一个确定性解释器扫描 τ ~ \tilde{\tau} 以构成协议边集 E p E_{\mathrm{p}}：每条边 ( i , j ) (i,j) 将一个源步骤与匹配到的后续步骤相连，例如工具请求与其结果相连，或委派与其执行相连。 该解释器支持下一匹配、全匹配、先进先出（FIFO）和后进先出（LIFO）配对，以适应不同的交互模式。 这些边引导分段并补充语义依赖。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on Who&When ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) and Who&When Pro ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Who&When contains 184 annotated failure trajectories from algorithm-generated and hand-crafted multi-agent systems; we pool both subsets for evaluation. From Pro, we select 300 text trajectories spanning eight single- and multi-agent frameworks, stratified by framework and failure-mode group with additional coverage constraints on trajectory length and error position. All methods use the same evaluation trajectories.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate attribution along three dimensions: responsible agent, error step, and failure mode. Agent measures responsible-agent accuracy on trajectories from multi-agent frameworks. It uses all 184 Who&When trajectories and, following Pro’s official Who evaluation protocol, 89 Pro text trajectories, excluding Smolagents, ALFAgent, and MathChat. Step measures exact error-step localization accuracy; Step ± 1 \pm 1 and Step ± 3 \pm 3 allow deviations of up to one and three steps, respectively. These metrics use all 184 Who&When and all 300 Pro text trajectories. Mode measures failure-mode classification accuracy on all 300 Pro text trajectories. We compare the three Who&When judges and DeFA; the other methods do not adopt Pro’s failure-mode taxonomy and are therefore excluded from this comparison, with dashes shown in the tables.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从三个维度评估归因：责任智能体、错误步骤和失败模式。 Agent 在来自多智能体框架的轨迹上衡量责任智能体准确率。 它使用全部 184 条 Who&When 轨迹，并按照 Pro 的官方 Who 评估协议使用 89 条 Pro 文本轨迹，其中排除了 Smolagents、ALFAgent 和 MathChat。 Step 衡量精确的错误步骤定位准确率；Step ± 1 \pm 1 和 Step ± 3 \pm 3 分别允许最多一步和三步的偏差。 这些指标使用全部 184 条 Who&When 轨迹和全部 300 条 Pro 文本轨迹。 Mode 在全部 300 条 Pro 文本轨迹上衡量失败模式分类准确率。 我们比较三个 Who&When 判定器与 DeFA；其他方法未采用 Pro 的失败模式分类体系，因此被排除在此比较之外，表格中以短横线表示。

paragraphs.en: Full DeFA leads all four metrics (Table 4 ). Removing segmentation lowers Step from 52.7% to 44.6%. Without the event dependency graph, Coverage falls to 77.7% and Step to 42.4%, supporting dependency context for candidate recall and tracing how steps use earlier information. Removing the failure propagation graph reduces Step to 40.8%; removing both graphs to 36.4%. paragraphs.en: With DeFA feedback, test accuracy improves over native Trace2Skill in all four settings by 6–15 percentage points, averaging 9.0 points (Figure 3 ). Both models benefit under each initialization, showing that DeFA’s diagnostic feedback can improve human-written and model-generated skills for subsequent tasks. Trajectory diagnosis and its full analytical outputs may also provide feedback for broader agent self-improvement and continual evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 在 DeFA 反馈的帮助下，四种设置下的测试准确率均比原生 Trace2Skill 提升了 6–15 个百分点，平均提升 9.0 个百分点（图 3）。 最大增幅出现在使用 Qwen3.5-Plus 和模型生成的初始技能时，准确率从 63% 提升至 78%。 两种模型在各种初始化方式下均有收益，表明 DeFA 的诊断反馈能够改进人工编写的和模型生成的技能，从而服务于后续任务。 轨迹诊断及其完整的分析输出还可以为更广泛的智能体自我改进和持续演化提供反馈。

paragraphs.en: We introduced DeFA, which traces agent failures through step dependencies. It combines protocol relations and semantic dependencies into an event dependency graph spanning the trajectory to capture how steps use earlier information. DeFA then identifies events that may violate task requirements and traces their sources and effects to construct a failure propagation graph. Final attribution uses this connected evidence to compare how steps introduce, transmit, or adopt errors and identify the decisive error and responsible agent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 DeFA，通过步骤依赖来追踪智能体的失败。 它将协议关系与语义依赖结合为一个横跨整条轨迹的事件依赖图，以捕捉步骤如何使用先前的信息。 随后，DeFA 识别可能违反任务要求的事件，并追踪其来源与影响，以构建失败传播图。 最终归因利用这些相互关联的证据，比较各步骤如何引入、传递或采纳错误，并识别决定性错误及责任智能体。

paragraphs.en: Experiments on Who&When and Who&When Pro demonstrate precise attribution gains across backbones, trajectory lengths, and text and multimodal inputs. Ablations support segmentation, the event dependency graph, and the failure propagation graph. DeFA’s diagnostic feedback also improves test accuracy after Trace2Skill skill evolution by an average of 9.0 percentage points over the native pipeline, showing that the diagnoses can guide skill improvements for subsequent tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Who&When 和 Who&When Pro 上的实验表明，跨骨干网络、轨迹长度以及文本和多模态输入，精确归因均获得提升。 消融实验验证了分段、事件依赖图和失败传播图的作用。 DeFA 的诊断反馈还使 Trace2Skill 技能演化后的测试准确率相较原生流程平均提升 9.0 个百分点，表明这些诊断能够指导后续任务的技能改进。

paragraphs.en: DeFA’s semantic dependency recovery and failure propagation analysis depend on the model’s trajectory interpretation; missing or misidentified relations can affect attribution, especially in long executions with dispersed evidence. Downstream utility has been evaluated for spreadsheet skill evolution; effectiveness in other domains and forms of agent improvement remains to be assessed. Future work can improve relation identification in long trajectories and broaden the applications of diagnostic feedback.
